notes: Virtual Kickoff (Module DSD-06-A Week 22). Topic: Week 22 Plan, Sprint 2 UI Integration & Testing. Activities: Overview of Sprint 2: connecting React UI to back-end APIs, managing state across routes, and end-to-end integration testing. Deliverables: Read Unit 6.2 Study Guide (pp. 30–60).

notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Sprint 2: React UI Component Construction. Activities: Daily Standup. Build interactive React UI components matching Figma high-fidelity wireframes created in Module 2. Deliverables: Front-End Component Set.

notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Sprint 2: Full-Stack Integration & Auth. Activities: Daily Standup. Wire up React front-end forms to live Laravel API endpoints. Handle user login authentication and route guards. Deliverables: Full-Stack Integrated Features.

notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Mid-Capstone Code Review & Architecture Audit. Activities: Execute full end-to-end system testing. Conduct Assessment 6.1: Instructor audit of Git hygiene, API routes, and UI state. Deliverables: Assessment 6.1 (Mid-Capstone Audit).

notes: Virtual Review. Topic: Week 22 Recap, Sprint 2 Review & Weekly Quiz 22. Activities: Review integration test results, resolve final app bugs, and administer weekly online quiz. Deliverables: Assessment 6.1 Evaluated & Weekly Quiz 22 Submitted.

notes: Virtual Kickoff (Module DSD-06-A Week 23). Topic: Week 23 Plan, Cloud Hosting & Portfolio Polish. Activities: Review production build optimizations, cloud database hosting (Render/Laravel Cloud), Vercel deployment, and portfolio layout. Deliverables: Read Unit 6.3 Study Guide.

title: Production Deployment: Back-End API & DB
notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Production Deployment: Back-End API & DB. Activities: Deploy Laravel API to Render/Laravel Cloud. Provision production MySQL database, run live migrations, and set CORS rules. Deliverables: Deployed Live Back-End API.

notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Production Deployment: React Front-End. Activities: Deploy React production build to Vercel/Netlify. Connect domain to production backend API URL via .env variables. Verify HTTPS. Deliverables: Deployed Live Front-End Web App.

notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Developer Portfolio & GitHub Documentation. Activities: Finalize personal portfolio site embedding live demo links, case studies, tech stacks, and source code GitHub README files. Deliverables: Assignment 6.2 (Portfolio & CV).

notes: Virtual Review. Topic: Week 23 Recap, Deployment Checks & Weekly Quiz 23. Activities: Verify live HTTPS web app deployment links, audit student portfolios, and conduct weekly online quiz. Deliverables: Assignment 6.2 Submitted & Weekly Quiz 23 Submitted.

notes: Virtual Kickoff (Module DSD-06-A Week 24). Topic: Week 24 Plan, ATS CV Formatting & Interview Prep. Activities: Overview of ATS resume formatting, technical interview questions, STAR behavioral method, and Demo Day presentation rules. Deliverables: Read Unit 6.3 Study Guide (pp. 31–50).

title: ATS Resume Workshop & Portfolio Audits
notes: Physical Lab. Topic: ATS Resume Workshop & Portfolio Audits. Activities: Format ATS-optimized developer CVs highlighting technical competencies, project metrics, ZQF Level 3 credential, and live portfolio URLs. Deliverables: Completed ATS Developer Resume.

title: Technical Mock Interview Simulations
notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Technical Mock Interview Simulations. Activities: Conduct simulated 1-on-1 technical job interviews in pairs. Practice live technical Q&A, algorithm whiteboarding, and STAR responses. Deliverables: Mock Interview Evaluation.

title: Demo Day Presentation Dry Run & Rehearsal
notes: Physical Lab. Topic: Demo Day Presentation Dry Run & Rehearsal. Activities: Conduct full 10-minute dry-run presentations of Capstone Projects. Verify live production app stability, slides, and timing limits. Deliverables: Final Presentation Slide Deck (.pptx).
